results.question: 인기도 상위 10% 작품을 주로 보는 유저 vs 나머지 작품을 보는 유저의 평점 성향 차이
results.generated_sql:
WITH popularity_threshold AS (
    SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY popularity_rank) as threshold
    FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance
),
user_preference AS (
    SELECT 
        u.user_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.popularity_rank <= p.threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as popular_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.popularity_rank > p.threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as other_count
    FROM main_marts.mart_user_segments u
    CROSS JOIN popularity_threshold p
    JOIN main_marts.mart_content_performance c ON 1=1 -- Note: Requires joining user watch history, assuming mart_user_segments maps to content engagement
    GROUP BY u.user_id
),
user_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        CASE WHEN popular_count >= other_count THEN 'Popular_Oriented' ELSE 'Other_Oriented' END as user_group
    FROM user_preference
)
SELECT 
    g.user_group,
    AVG(u.avg_rating) as avg_rating,
    AVG(u.stddev_rating) as avg_stddev_rating,
    AVG(u.high_rating_ratio) as avg_high_rating_ratio
FROM main_marts.mart_user_segments u
JOIN user_groups g ON u.user_id = g.user_id
GROUP BY g.user_group;

results.question: Members 상위 1% 작품의 장르 분포 vs 전체 작품의 장르 분포
results.generated_sql:
WITH top_1_percent AS (
    SELECT 
        genre, 
        COUNT(*) AS genre_count,
        SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() AS total_count_top
    FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance,
         UNNEST(string_split(genres, ', ')) AS genre
    WHERE members >= (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY members) FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance)
    GROUP BY genre
),
total_distribution AS (
    SELECT 
        genre, 
        COUNT(*) AS genre_count,
        SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() AS total_count_all
    FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance,
         UNNEST(string_split(genres, ', ')) AS genre
    GROUP BY genre
)
SELECT 
    t.genre,
    CAST(top.genre_count AS DOUBLE) / top.total_count_top AS top_1_percent_distribution,
    CAST(t.genre_count AS DOUBLE) / t.total_count_all AS all_anime_distribution
FROM total_distribution t
LEFT JOIN top_1_percent top ON t.genre = top.genre
ORDER BY all_anime_distribution DESC;

results.question: Members 상위 1% 작품의 장르 분포 vs 전체 작품의 장르 분포
results.generated_sql:
WITH genre_split AS (
    SELECT 
        genre,
        count(*) as total_count,
        sum(case when members_tier = 'Top 1%' then 1 else 0 end) as top_1_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            unnest(string_split(genres, ', ')) as genre,
            members_tier
        FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance
        WHERE genres IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    genre,
    total_count,
    total_count * 1.0 / (SELECT count(*) FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance) as total_distribution,
    top_1_count,
    top_1_count * 1.0 / (SELECT count(*) FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance WHERE members_tier = 'Top 1%') as top_1_distribution
FROM genre_split
ORDER BY top_1_distribution DESC;
